key_insight: CoPiT explicitly modulates aerodynamic field predictions with global operating and design conditions while preserving geometry-based attention on unstructured meshes.
engineering_relevance: It offers a surrogate for costly RANS simulations in repeated aerodynamic design exploration, optimization, and multi-condition evaluation.
method: Use the Position-induced Transformer as a mesh-flexible geometric backbone.
Inject global conditions through multi-stage feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM).
Preserve geometry-based attention weights while conditioning intermediate features.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on 2D AirfRANS and 3D BlendedNet++, CoPiT reduces AirfRANS full-data surface and volume losses by approximately 54% and 24% versus Transolver and achieves the lowest overall normalized test MSE among compared BlendedNet++ baselines.
watch_item: The preferred FiLM placement is task-dependent, so conditioning stages require validation for each application.
paper_title: CoPiT: A conditional Position-induced Transformer for aerodynamic field prediction on unstructured meshes
